description: Sample player for a folder of WAV files, playing every channel of a multi-channel file at once through a polyphonic output

params.text: Picks which file in the folder plays, from the first to the last
Attenuates the SAMPLE selection CV, from nothing through to its full range
When on, playback returns to the start position as it passes the end position
Steps forward one file in the folder; with a cable in the SAMPLE CV input this has no effect
Steps back one file in the folder; with a cable in the SAMPLE CV input this has no effect
Restarts the chosen file from its start position
Sets where playback begins, from the start of the file to its end
Attenuates the START CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets where playback ends, from the start of the file to its end; a start later than the end swaps the two
Attenuates the END CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets how long the fade in at the start of the played region lasts, from none to half the region
Attenuates the ATTACK CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets how long the fade down lasts, from none to half the region; turned fully clockwise the level is held instead
Attenuates the DECAY CV, from nothing through to its full range
Attenuates the pitch CV, from nothing through to its full range
Attenuates the volume CV, from nothing through to its full range
Splits the played region into 1 to 16 parts, and EOC fires at the end of each one

inputs.text: A rising edge restarts the chosen file from its start position; with nothing patched here the file plays without waiting
Adds to the file selection after its attenuator, 0-10V spanning the whole folder
Sets the level, 10V for full level falling to silence at 0V, read per channel from a polyphonic cable
Shifts the playback speed by a volt per octave after the attenuator, read per channel from a polyphonic cable
A rising edge steps forward one file in the folder
A rising edge steps back one file in the folder
Adds to the start position after its attenuator, 0-10V covering the whole file
Adds to the end position after its attenuator, 0-10V covering the whole file
Adds to the attack time after its attenuator, 0-10V covering its full range
Adds to the decay time after its attenuator, 0-10V covering its full range
Above 1V playback returns to the start position as it passes the end position

outputs.text: The first channel of the file being played, -5V to 5V
The second channel of the file being played; a single-channel file is carried on both of these outputs
Every channel of the file on its own polyphonic channel, -5V to 5V
A 1ms 10V trigger at the end of the played region, and at each division point set by DIVISION

notes: the outputs stay silent until a folder is chosen with Select Directory Containing WAV Files in the right-click menu; the module holds no files of its own
menu: Select Directory Containing WAV Files — points the module at a folder of files to play
Sample Change Behavior — Restart begins a newly chosen file at the start position, Continual carries on from the position already reached
Envelope Mode — AD Envelope (decay after attack), Start/End (attack at start, decay at end), or Disabled
Smoothing — fades across a jump in playback rather than cutting it, which removes the click
